item.title: What is the What
item.description:
What is the What by Dave Eggers

Summary

“What is the What” is a biographical novel by Dave Eggers that recounts the life story of Valentino Achak Deng, a Sudanese refugee and one of the “Lost Boys” of Sudan. The novel details his harrowing journey from his village in Sudan, which was destroyed during the Second Sudanese Civil War, to refugee camps in Ethiopia and Kenya, and eventually to his resettlement in the United States. Through Denn’s journey, the book sheds light on the struggle for survival, identity, and a sense of belonging. It deftly explores themes of war, displacement, resilience, and the quest for dignity amidst profound adversity.
